pattern.pattern_details: NC growth is concentrated in one provider, DUKE UNIVERSITY HEALTH SYSTEM INC, across both operational and clinical signals. The pattern combines higher authorized admission volume in Not Mapped facility claims with a small number of very high-cost transplant-related cases. This is a concentrated provider economics story, but mapping issues need to be resolved so the true facility and payment picture is clear.
pattern.why_it_matters: A single-provider concentration of this size can move results quickly, but actions will differ depending on whether the increase is driven by legitimate case severity, facility attribution, or reimbursement terms.
pattern.recommended_next_step: Open a joint network, UM, and data-quality review with DUKE UNIVERSITY HEALTH SYSTEM INC to separate transplant outliers from mapped inpatient growth and confirm the correct facility attribution on Not Mapped claims.
pattern.validation_reason: Not Mapped facility values and a small not-mapped clinical outlier mean provider concentration should be confirmed before taking reimbursement or utilization action.
evidence_summary: DUKE UNIVERSITY HEALTH SYSTEM INC heart transplant and assist-system cases added +$1.6M from 3 admissions, including one case at +$1.0M.
DUKE UNIVERSITY HEALTH SYSTEM INC TANF Standard Not Mapped utilization added +$1.6M from 20 more admissions despite lower paid per admit, showing volume-led growth.
DUKE UNIVERSITY HEALTH SYSTEM INC ABD Non Dual Not Mapped added +$0.8M with 9 more admissions and about +$89.3K paid per admit.
An additional not-mapped DUKE UNIVERSITY HEALTH SYSTEM INC clinical case added +$0.2M, reinforcing the attribution issue.
